implementation.evidence: IDS contains all nine current appearance criteria and general_result returns whole-face measurements plus skinType.
analyze_skin produces regional measurements, maps, contours and overview values; acne/dry/oil/eye/line/contour paths are explicit.
POST /skin executes the local product analysis under park, consent, disconnect, eyewear and bounded-worker controls.
The UI dictionary and measurement contract expose the same nine criteria and distinguish appearance proxies from independently validated values.
The overview contract requires all nine criteria and a separate normal/dry/oily/combination skin type.
The camera flow attaches appearance results, overview, local maps and contours, validates them and persists accepted records.
The result view supports criterion selection and regional result inspection.

localSkinType.combinationRule: T-zone oily plus complete supported non-T normal/dry observations
localSkinType.meaning: visible-support rule; not sebum or hydration ground truth

interpretation: The roadmap extends and validates an already functioning result flow; it is not a greenfield integration.
A visible product score is not automatically an accuracy claim. Several current outputs are analytic appearance proxies and carry limitations in their contract.
Post acne and Pigmentation remain the two new product headings; source dataset classes are not additional product headings.
Future model promotion must preserve the current consent, quality, persistence, map and history contracts.
